newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight enquiry steady in slow start to week.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight enquiry steady in slow start to week.

text.p: The sugar freight market got off to a quiet start on Monday with little firm business reported, shipbrokers said.
Of the day's fresh inquiry, E D & F Man quoted for 10,300 tonnes of bagged sugar from Cadiz to Algeria for mid-October.
The same charterer was also open for a further 12/12,200 tonnes in bulk from Port St. Louis and Beira to US Gulf/Atlantic for 20/30 October.
Genoc was in the market for 13/14,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from south Brazil to Baltic with options of Mediterranean, Black Sea, Red Sea and Indian Ocean for prompt shipment dates.
Shipbrokers said the only firm business came from Jean Lion, which fixed 14,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from north Brazil to Morocco/Tunisia/Syria for October dates.
